name: fast_google_maps_scraper
description: HTTP-first Google Maps scraper for search listings, place details, reviews, lead scoring, and optional website enrichment.
capabilities: Low-cost prospecting and lead generation from Google Maps business listings.
Building lists of businesses with names, ratings, categories, addresses, coordinates, and place identifiers.
Fetching full place details for lead qualification and outreach prioritization.
Collecting and analyzing customer reviews for sentiment, volume, and per-place review datasets.
Enriching business websites to extract emails, social links, page titles, and contact pages for outreach.
Targeted local searches using city/country, structured geolocation fields, custom lat/long anchors, radius or GeoJSON points.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: list searches only and is cheapest; place scrapes one known place ID; search lists places, fetches details, and optionally reviews.

inputs.name: outputMode
inputs.description: Choose which records are saved to the Dataset. list mode always returns listing records.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Business/category query, for example 'dentists' or 'coffee shops'. Required for list and search mode.

inputs.name: searchLocation
inputs.description: Free-form location such as Berlin, Germany. Used together with the search query.

inputs.name: geolocationParameters
inputs.description: Optional structured location fields. These are used when the free-form location is empty.

inputs.name: customGeolocation
inputs.description: Optional geometry and coordinate fields for anchoring the Google Maps search area.

inputs.name: placeId
inputs.description: Known Google Maps place ID. Required for place mode.

inputs.name: maxPlaces
inputs.description: Maximum number of search results to list or fully scrape.

inputs.name: maxReviews
inputs.description: Maximum reviews to fetch for each place. Set to 0 to skip reviews.

inputs.name: maxTotalReviews
inputs.description: Global review cap across the whole run. Set to 0 for no global cap.

inputs.name: maxConcurrency
inputs.description: Number of places to scrape in parallel in search mode. Higher values are faster but can increase blocking risk.

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.description: Google Maps zoom level. Higher values narrow the search area.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Google hl language parameter.

inputs.name: gl
inputs.description: Google gl country parameter.

inputs.name: delaySeconds
inputs.description: Minimum delay between HTTP requests. Actual delay is randomized up to 2x this value.

inputs.name: timeoutSeconds
inputs.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds.

inputs.name: proxyConfiguration
inputs.description: Use Apify Proxy or custom proxies.

inputs.name: proxyUrl
inputs.description: Optional direct proxy URL used when Apify Proxy is disabled.

inputs.name: enrichWebsites
inputs.description: Fetch listed websites to extract title, description, emails, and social links.

inputs.name: websiteEnrichmentDepth
inputs.description: Homepage only is fastest. Contact pages also checks contact/about/impressum pages for emails and social links.

inputs.name: websiteTimeoutSeconds
inputs.description: Timeout for each website enrichment request. Keep this lower than the Google Maps timeout to avoid slow websites increasing run cost.

inputs.name: skipSocialWebsites
inputs.description: Skip website enrichment when Google Maps lists a social profile such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, or Twitter. This is faster and avoids many 429 responses.

inputs.name: leadFilters
inputs.description: Optional filters applied after full place details are fetched. Filtered places are skipped from Dataset output and reviews.

inputs.name: enableSqliteCheckpoint
inputs.description: Keep an internal SQLite copy for deduplication/checkpointing. Dataset remains the primary output.

inputs.name: sqlitePath
inputs.description: Internal SQLite path when checkpointing is enabled.

inputs.name: enableBillingEvents
inputs.description: Legacy testing flag. Production monetization is enabled automatically when pay-per-event pricing is configured in Apify Console. For local tests, use ACTOR_TEST_PAY_PER_EVENT=true.

outputs.name: place_name
outputs.description: Business or place name when available.

outputs.name: address
outputs.description: Detected street address or location text when available.
